title: Seoul scrambles to limit damage after Lee's passport info leaked
caption:
South Korea is scrambling to secure its presidential travel protocols after a massive data leak exposed the private information of the president, his aides, and his security detail. Officials are currently investigating how a sensitive passenger list ended up public on a cybersecurity site.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul scrambles to limit damage after Lee's passport info leaked
